transcript.text: This package is a shared library rather than a routed app, so there is no app entry or `index.html` in scope. The runtime context I’ve found so far is mostly component/provider based: Auth, Toast, router-backed hooks/components, localStorage pagination keys, and a small amount of fetch in Auth actions rather than render.
